description: The tenth and last valued entry of app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy - 'Bill Payment' targeting COBIL00C - chosen by a regular user. This is the upper end of the OCCURS table's active range and the companion to case04's lower end: WS-OPTION of 10 must satisfy WS-OPTION > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT as FALSE, because app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:128 compares against the count of 10 inclusively. An exclusive bound would reject the last option, and an off-by-one in the 1-based-to-0-based conversion would dispatch to CORPT00C, the ninth entry, instead - so the expected target name is what distinguishes a correct table read from either mistake. The two-character option image '10' also exercises the normalisation scan finding a non-space in byte two.
